entries.text: 没什么。再见。
entries.source_text: 没什么。再见。

entries.text: A bit sure of yourself. I have no need for you.# Talk to Nicole if you wish to offer your services.  Good night.
entries.source_text:
A bit sure of yourself. I have no need for you.
# Talk to Nicole if you wish to offer your services.  Good night.

entries.text: 你太自以为是了。我不需要你。如果你愿提供你的服务，找妮可尔谈谈。晚安。
entries.source_text: 你太自以为是了。我不需要你。如果你愿提供你的服务，找妮可尔谈谈。晚安。

entries.text: Then you will want to search out Nicole. She can help# you better with that. Good evening.
entries.source_text:
Then you will want to search out Nicole. She can help
# you better with that. Good evening.

entries.text: 那你就应该找妮可尔。她能帮你。晚安。
entries.source_text: 那你就应该找妮可尔。她能帮你。晚安。

entries.text: Go find that spy. We need to keep our plans secret still longer.
entries.source_text: Go find that spy. We need to keep our plans secret still longer.

entries.text: 去找出那奸细。我们得长久保持计划的绝密。
entries.source_text: 去找出那奸细。我们得长久保持计划的绝密。

entries.text: Good job on finding and removing Heather. Her meddling# nearly got everyone killed. I wish there was something more we could do.
entries.source_text:
Good job on finding and removing Heather. Her meddling
# nearly got everyone killed. I wish there was something more we could do.

entries.text: 做的不错，你找到并且除掉了希瑟。她差点把我们都卖了。我希望我们能一起做更多的工作。
entries.source_text: 做的不错，你找到并且除掉了希瑟。她差点把我们都卖了。我希望我们能一起做更多的工作。

entries.text: Perhaps I can help you once more.
entries.source_text: Perhaps I can help you once more.

entries.text: 或许我可以再帮你一次。
entries.source_text: 或许我可以再帮你一次。

entries.text: Good luck to you.
entries.source_text: Good luck to you.

entries.text: 祝你好运。
entries.source_text: 祝你好运。

entries.text: How so?
entries.source_text: How so?

entries.text: 那又如何？
entries.source_text: 那又如何？

entries.text: I can train the Followers in some skills for war. Maybe# your chances will improve.
entries.source_text:
I can train the Followers in some skills for war. Maybe
# your chances will improve.

entries.text: 我可以训练末世论者一些战斗的技能。或许你的机遇会改善些。
entries.source_text: 我可以训练末世论者一些战斗的技能。或许你的机遇会改善些。

entries.text: I can leave. Good bye.
entries.source_text: I can leave. Good bye.

entries.text: 我得走了。再见。
entries.source_text: 我得走了。再见。

entries.text: That would be wonderful. Thank you.
entries.source_text: That would be wonderful. Thank you.

entries.text: 真令人愉快。谢谢你了。
entries.source_text: 真令人愉快。谢谢你了。

entries.text: Now you are a bit more prepared. Good evening.
entries.source_text: Now you are a bit more prepared. Good evening.

entries.text: 现在你有点准备了吧。晚安。
entries.source_text: 现在你有点准备了吧。晚安。

entries.text: Thank you for your teachings. Now we have a chance to# beat back those Children.
entries.source_text:
Thank you for your teachings. Now we have a chance to
# beat back those Children.

entries.text: 谢谢你的教学。现在我们有条件打翻那些个大教堂教徒了。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你的教学。现在我们有条件打翻那些个大教堂教徒了。
